name: Prismite · Gremlet #17
description:
A jewel beetle whose shell throws tiny rainbows on the wall whenever the sun hits it.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Prismite in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
